title: The Ethnoarchaeology of a Cotahuasi Salt Caravan
lineage: Inspected the cited passages; the retained file is a paraphrased research note.

passages.note: The fieldwork account describes four Quechua-speaking herders and 28 llamas carrying Huarhua salt for exchange during a July 2007 journey in southern Peru; a modern observation is not a direct witness of an ancient caravan.
